origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.name: Acolyte
origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.descr: Acolytes enwetala ọzụzụ site n'aka ndị ụkọchukwu ma nwee nnukwu okwukwe.
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.name: Onye na-eme egwuregwu
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.descr: Ndị na-eme egwuregwu zụrụ ahụ ha ka ha zuo okè.
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.name: Aka oru ugbo
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.desc: Ha na-etinye oge na-arụ ọrụ n'ugbo onye ọzọ.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.name: Ndị na-akụ azụ̀
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.descri: Ndị na-akụ azụ̀ amụtala nkà ịkụ azụ̀.
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.name: Chebe
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.descrip: Ichebe ndị ọzọ na ihe onwunwe ha akụzierela ha ichebe onwe ha.
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.name: Akpọrọ asị
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.descr: Ọ dịghị ndị bịara abịa n'ọchịchịrị na ọdachi, ndị Emume na-ebu ọnyà ha na-agba nkịtị. Na-emekarị.
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.name: Njide
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.desc: Ịga n'ihu n'ọdịnala ezinụlọ nke ijere Onye-nwe ma ọ bụ Knight ozi.
origin.origins_backgrounds.novice_mage.d: Ndị ọhụrụ malitere ọzụzụ n'okpuru nkuzi Ọkachamara.
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.name: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ mmiri
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.descri: Ndị na-akwọ ụgbọ mmiri na-etinye oge dị ukwuu n'ịsacha oche ahụ.
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.name: Pirate
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.descri: Naanị ịhụnanya ha bụ oké osimiri. Na emeralds. Ọtụtụ emeralds.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.name: Onye isi okpukpe
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.descr: Ndị òtù nzuzo na-efe chi ha n'ụzọ dị omimi.
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.name: ode akwukwo
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.name: Onye agha
origin.origins_backgrounds.fresh_face.de: Ha emebeghị ihe ọ bụla dị ịrịba ama. Ma.
origin.origins_backgrounds.coalminer.des: Ọ dị mkpa ka e gwupụta mmanụ niile dị n'okpuru ala, ọ bụghị naanị coal.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cryptkeeper.d: Ilekọta ili nke ndị nwụrụ anwụ bụ ịrụsi ọrụ ike ma ọ bụrụ na ha adịghị anọ.
power.origins_backgrounds.improved_heali: Ọgwụgwọ nwere 10% mmetụta ka ukwuu maka gị.
power.origins_backgrounds.faster_speed.d: A na-abawanye mmegharị ala gị site na 10%.
Ị na-enwetakwu Nri site n'iri azụ esiri esi. (anaghị egosi na AppleSkin)
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: Mgbe ị na-eji ọta, ị na-enweta Resistance I.
power.origins_backgrounds.hello_darkness: Ị gaghị enwe mmetụta nke ọchịchịrị.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: Ị nwere ọnyà Ígwè a na-anụ ọkụ n'obi nke e bufere n'ọgbọ.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: Mgbe ị nọ n'oké osimiri, ọgụ gị na-agba ọsọ ugboro abụọ.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: anyapachi
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.descr: Yiri anya nku anya na oke osimiri mepere emepe na-enye gị ohere idobe ọhụụ abalị gị.
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.name: Laghachi na Crypts gị
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.descrip: Ihe ọmụma gị banyere ndị nwụrụ anwụ na-enye gị ohere ịmebi 7.5% karịa ndị nwụrụ anwụ.
power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: Ị na-ebu mma agha ezinụlọ gị. Ọ bụ nke nna gị, na nke nne ya na...
power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: Mgbe ị dechara ọtụtụ akwụkwọ, naanị ị ga-achọ akwụkwọ atọ iji kee otu.
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.name: Nnụnụ àjà
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: Ịchụ ọkụkọ n'aka nna gị ukwu na-enye gị ahụmahụ okpukpu abụọ.
Omume gị na mma agha na-enye gị ohere ime 5% mmebi ọzọ mgbe ị na-eji otu.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: Ị riela ọtụtụ ọgwụ ndị na-edozi ahụ ma na-agwọ ọrịa.
